originality.rationale: The motivating primary text supplies exactly the two marginal statistics, not their cross moment. The new conditional mixed increment and its root-degree-two exception produce the claimed joint recurrence and constant. Related preferential-attachment and recursive-tree sources are different processes; unindexed stronger results remain a real priority risk.
residual_risks: A published analogous square-root hub–leaf covariance for a distinct degree-proportional growing tree shows that the qualitative effect is not universally new; no implication to the HSC(2) coefficient was identified.
The older 2004 and 2010 papers were compared via abstracts only, not entire bodies.
Unindexed or differently formulated general results could imply the finite recurrence; semantic search alone does not prove novelty.

value.rationale: The precise dependence of a persistent founding hub on an extensive minimal-degree population is a natural missing joint invariant of the motivating complex. It requires a new auxiliary-neighbor closure and a root-degree-two boundary correction, yields strict all-size sign plus an exact asymptotic coefficient, and distinguishes growing covariance from vanishing correlation. Separate known marginal laws do not answer the joint question.
